Hi Leah —

Thanks for the clear asks. I put together a short proposal we can use as a starting point and attached a one-page playbook plus an M.A.P (mutual action plan) workbook. Key points up front:

- Support ladder: three tiers (Standard -> Priority -> Priority+) with defined response and update cadence by severity. Priority gives 1-hour P1 response SLA and a 4-hour P2 response; Priority+ gives 30-minute P1 response and dedicated on-call routing during business hours.
- Latency SLOs: we can commit to a 99th-percentile tail latency target for text generation endpoints at the Priority+ tier (with model/version pinning and request shaping); exact target depends on token profiles — estimate: 99p <= 750ms for small-medium prompts on the curated model bundle.
- Burst commitment: we offer a seasonal burst pool (pre-booked GPU hours) and an automatic fallback ladder. For Black Friday we recommend reserving a 2x burst pool relative to your peak Q3 usage; unused burst is credited at 30% refund applied to next billing period.
- Commercials: to move to Priority+ we propose a +35% uplift on committed monthly spend and a 12-month amendment that includes 60% of burst pool reserved capacity.

I’m happy to run these numbers with Marissa and Karthik on call. If that sounds reasonable I’ll schedule a demo of the priority routing and we can share the MAP workbook for your procurement.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
